description: maven: a pom.xml <groupId> referencing an undefined ${property} has no identity to report, so the dependency is dropped with a warning naming file and line and no purl ever carries the raw ${...} text (the warning is this case's exit 1). Also exercises the pom's own self-identity emission: this pom's own fully-resolved coordinates are additionally emitted as a High-confidence self-identity component, adding no warning of its own
